typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchiveFolder as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	File_IID as integer (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportFolder as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_FATAL as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_INFO as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_WARNING as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_COMPLETE as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_START as string (),
	WorksheetName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{SRC_HC_ID (sort asc))} as string,
		CLM_DIAG_1_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(MemberNumber = {SRC_HC_ID (sort asc))} + '00') ~> TrimFields
TrimFields derive(CLM_DIAG_1_CD_NonUnicode = CLM_DIAG_1_CD,
		MemberNumber_NonUnicode = MemberNumber) ~> ConverttoNonUnicode
ConverttoNonUnicode sink(input(
		CALLLIST_385_ER_STAGING_CLM_DIAG_1_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_385_ER_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_385_ER_STAGING_CLM_DIAG_1_CD = CLM_DIAG_1_CD_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_385_ER_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNumber_NonUnicode)) ~> PDSCALLLIST385ERSTAGING
